# Generated Persistent hand-discard guards

The fresh Stygian/LazarusLeague first battle wins, but selecting the planned
elixir repeatedly restarts search. Native capture adds Persistent discard
callback/routing markers when the elixir first enters the hand. The model
previously removed obsolete markers but could not introduce new ones, so
the full continuation key correctly rejected the incomplete forecast.

AfterActionInteractions now derives Persistent/Freeze discard markers from
the complete post-action hand's captured trait descriptors. Missing or
unresolvable descriptors preserve the previous conservative guard state.
State keys and real RNG remain fully checked; no continuation field is
ignored to force a match.

The original and repaired independent native processes reproduce all eight
inputs through the first Mix choice. Full successors/RNG and immutable
parents match; the focused checker additionally compares the native guard
lists, preserves the old forecast's omission, and requires both repaired
markers. Replaying the original first-battle plan against its native roots
now matches all28 available continuation positions. A fresh actual player
battle then executed37 inputs with no new search after its first action,
including repeated Mix choices. Its terminal physical spawn-point projection
still differs from native; this fresh run is retained as an incomplete
acceptance trace, not a fully verified battle. The original 0.2.41 first
two battles have separate, complete native winning pairs.

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Check-Models.ps1 -SkipBuild -Fixture player-generated-discard-guard-calibration.mt2f
```
